name: G63 Bluetooth Speaker with Wireless Charger | Atmosphere Wake-Up Light | Bedside Music Lamp | Multi-Mode Lighting
description:
G63 Bluetooth Speaker with Wireless Charger | Atmosphere Wake-Up Light | Bedside Music Lamp | Multi-Mode Lighting

Transform your room into a smart, stylish, and relaxing space with the G63 Bluetooth Speaker with Wireless Charging & Atmosphere Light. This all-in-one device combines a powerful Bluetooth speaker, 10W wireless charger, bedside lamp, and colorful ambient lighting into one sleek unit. Designed for bedrooms, offices, and study tables, it works as a wake-up light, night lamp, phone charger, and music player at the same time. With multiple lighting modes, it creates a soothing or party-style atmosphere based on your mood. Enjoy music through Bluetooth, AUX, TF card, U-disk, or FM, giving you complete freedom to play audio your way. Perfect for bedside tables, gaming rooms, and modern home setups.

Key Features:
10W Wireless Fast Charging for smartphones
Bluetooth 5.3 Speaker with clear powerful sound
Atmosphere & Wake-Up Light with multiple lighting modes
Dazzling RGB Light Effects
Bedside Lamp + Music Player + Charger in One
Multiple Music Modes – Bluetooth, AUX, TF Card, U-Disk, FM
TWS Support (Works in Bluetooth Mode)
Touch & Button Control
Compact & Stylish Design
Ideal for Bedroom, Office, Study Table & Home Decor

Product Details:
Model: G63
Input Voltage: 12V / 2.5A
Wireless Output: 5W – 10W Max
Bluetooth Power: 5W
Bluetooth Version: 5.3
Battery Capacity: 500mAh
Charging Efficiency: 75%
Transmission Distance: 5–10 m
Frequency Response: 50Hz – 20kHz
Light Modes: Multiple
Color: White / Black
Net Weight: 280g

Special Notes:
Use a 12V 2.5A adapter for best wireless charging performance
Place phone properly on charging area for fast charging
TWS function works only in Bluetooth mode
Keep device away from water and high heat
Charge fully before first use
Do not block speaker or light vents
